types.name: BusinessType
types.description: The legal structure of the applicant business.

values.description: A business type not otherwise modeled.

types.name: DirectorIDType
types.description: The type of identification document supplied as Director ID.

values.description: A form of identification not modeled as valid director ID.

types.name: CollateralAssetType
types.description: The type of asset provided as security for a secured business loan.

values.description: An asset type not otherwise modeled.

rules.alternateExpression: lastAccountingDateWithinPast12Months is equal to lastAccountingDateWithinPast12Months
if hasRecentBankStatements is true, then bankStatementsMonthsCount is at least 3
if hasRecentBankStatements is true, then mostRecentStatementAgeDays is less than 90
if hasRecentBankStatements is false, then bankStatementsMonthsCount is less than 3 or mostRecentStatementAgeDays is at least 90
if isUKBased is true, then isRegisteredInUK is true
if isUKBased is true, then hasUKAddress is true
if isUKBased is false, then isRegisteredInUK is false or hasUKAddress is false
if hasCompaniesHouseMatch is true, then isRegisteredInUK is true
if hasCompaniesHouseMatch is true, then hasUKAddress is true
if isEligibleBusinessType is true, then businessType is equal to BusinessType_LIMITED_COMPANY or businessType is equal to BusinessType_PARTNERSHIP
if isEligibleBusinessType is false, then businessType is not equal to BusinessType_LIMITED_COMPANY
if isEligibleBusinessType is false, then businessType is not equal to BusinessType_PARTNERSHIP
if hasValidDirectorID is true, then directorIDType is equal to DirectorIDType_DRIVERS_LICENCE or directorIDType is equal to DirectorIDType_PASSPORT
if hasValidDirectorID is false, then directorIDType is not equal to DirectorIDType_DRIVERS_LICENCE
if hasValidDirectorID is false, then directorIDType is not equal to DirectorIDType_PASSPORT
if isApplicantAgeEligible is true, then applicantAge is at least 18
if isApplicantAgeEligible is false, then applicantAge is less than 18
if loanAmountInRange is true, then loanAmount is at least 25000
if loanAmountInRange is true, then loanAmount is no more than 20000000
if loanAmountInRange is false, then loanAmount is less than 25000 or loanAmount is greater than 20000000
loanTermMonths is at least 12
loanTermMonths is no more than 72
if hasRequiredDocuments is true, then hasRecentBankStatements is true
if hasRequiredDocuments is true, then hasAnnualAccounts is true
if hasRequiredDocuments is true, then hasProofOfCollateralOwnershipValuation is true

if hasRequiredDocuments is false, then at least one of the following 3 statements is true: 1) hasRecentBankStatements is false; 2) hasAnnualAccounts is false; 3) hasProofOfCollateralOwnershipValuation is false

rules.expression:
(=> hasSecurityAsset
    (or (= collateralAssetType
           CollateralAssetType_PROPERTY)
        (= collateralAssetType
           CollateralAssetType_EQUIPMENT)
        (= collateralAssetType
           CollateralAssetType_VEHICLES)
        (= collateralAssetType
           CollateralAssetType_INVOICES)
        (= collateralAssetType
           CollateralAssetType_INTANGIBLE_ASSETS)))
rules.alternateExpression: if hasSecurityAsset is true, then at least one of the following 5 statements is true: 1) collateralAssetType is equal to CollateralAssetType_PROPERTY; 2) collateralAssetType is equal to CollateralAssetType_EQUIPMENT; 3) collateralAssetType is equal to CollateralAssetType_VEHICLES; 4) collateralAssetType is equal to CollateralAssetType_INVOICES; 5) collateralAssetType is equal to CollateralAssetType_INTANGIBLE_ASSETS
if hasSecurityAsset is false, then collateralAssetType is not equal to CollateralAssetType_PROPERTY
if hasSecurityAsset is false, then collateralAssetType is not equal to CollateralAssetType_EQUIPMENT
if hasSecurityAsset is false, then collateralAssetType is not equal to CollateralAssetType_VEHICLES
if hasSecurityAsset is false, then collateralAssetType is not equal to CollateralAssetType_INVOICES
if hasSecurityAsset is false, then collateralAssetType is not equal to CollateralAssetType_INTANGIBLE_ASSETS
if meetsMinimumTradingHistory is true, then tradingHistoryMonths is at least 12
if meetsMinimumTradingHistory is false, then tradingHistoryMonths is less than 12
if isSubstantivelyEligible is true, then isUKBased is true
if isSubstantivelyEligible is true, then isEligibleBusinessType is true
if isSubstantivelyEligible is true, then hasValidDirectorID is true
if isSubstantivelyEligible is true, then isApplicantAgeEligible is true
if isSubstantivelyEligible is true, then loanAmountInRange is true
if isSubstantivelyEligible is true, then loanTermMonths is at least 12
if isSubstantivelyEligible is true, then loanTermMonths is no more than 72
if isSubstantivelyEligible is true, then hasSecurityAsset is true
if isSubstantivelyEligible is true, then meetsMinimumTradingHistory is true

rules.expression:
(=> (not isSubstantivelyEligible)
    (or (not isUKBased)
        (not isEligibleBusinessType)
        (not hasValidDirectorID)
        (not isApplicantAgeEligible)
        (not loanAmountInRange)
        (not (>= loanTermMonths 12))
        (not (<= loanTermMonths 72))
        (not hasSecurityAsset)
        (not meetsMinimumTradingHistory)))
rules.alternateExpression: if isSubstantivelyEligible is false, then at least one of the following 9 statements is true: 1) isUKBased is false; 2) isEligibleBusinessType is false; 3) hasValidDirectorID is false; 4) isApplicantAgeEligible is false; 5) loanAmountInRange is false; 6) loanTermMonths is less than 12; 7) loanTermMonths is greater than 72; 8) hasSecurityAsset is false; 9) meetsMinimumTradingHistory is false
if isUnconditionallyApproved is true, then isSubstantivelyEligible is true
if isUnconditionallyApproved is true, then hasRequiredDocuments is true
if isUnconditionallyApproved is false, then isSubstantivelyEligible is false or hasRequiredDocuments is false

variables.name: bankStatementsMonthsCount
variables.description: The number of months of bank statements supplied by the applicant. Policy requires at least 3 months.

variables.name: mostRecentStatementAgeDays
variables.description: The age, in days, of the most recent bank statement measured from the date of application. Policy requires this to be less than 90 days.

variables.name: hasRecentBankStatements
variables.description: True if the supplied bank statements meet the recency/sufficiency rule: at least 3 months of statements and the most recent statement is less than 90 days old on the date of application. Determined deterministically by the check_bank_statements_recent_and_sufficient tool.

variables.name: isRegisteredInUK
variables.description: True if the business is registered in the UK (i.e. has a UK registration).

variables.name: hasUKAddress
variables.description: True if the business has a UK address.

variables.name: isUKBased
variables.description: True if the business is UK-based, meaning it is registered in the UK and has a UK address.

variables.name: hasCompaniesHouseMatch
variables.description: True if there is a confirmed Companies House match for the business (via the check_companies_house check). A confirmed match is itself proof that the business is both registered in the UK and has a UK address.

variables.name: businessType
variables.description: The legal structure of the applicant business. Must be a limited company or partnership (not a sole trader) to be eligible.

variables.name: isEligibleBusinessType
variables.description: True if the business is an eligible business type: a limited company or a partnership (not a sole trader).

variables.name: lastAccountingDateWithinPast12Months
variables.description: True if the last accounting date of the filed accounts (accounting statements or annual reports) is within the past 12 months from the date of application.

variables.name: directorIDType
variables.description: The type of identification document supplied as Director ID. Valid Director ID is a driver's licence or a passport.

variables.name: hasValidDirectorID
variables.description: True if a valid Director ID (a driver's licence or a passport) has been supplied.

variables.name: applicantAge
variables.description: The age of the applicant in years. Must be 18 or older to be eligible.

variables.name: isApplicantAgeEligible
variables.description: True if the applicant is aged 18 or older.

variables.name: loanAmount
variables.description: The requested secured business loan amount in GBP. Must be between £25,000 and £20,000,000 inclusive.

variables.name: loanAmountInRange
variables.description: True if the requested loan amount falls within the £25,000–£20,000,000 range. Determined deterministically by the check_secured_business_loan_amount_in_range tool.

variables.name: loanTermMonths
variables.description: The requested loan term in months for a secured business loan. Must be between 12 and 72 months inclusive.

variables.name: hasAnnualAccounts
variables.description: True if the applicant has supplied annual accounts as required for a secured business loan.

variables.name: hasProofOfCollateralOwnershipValuation
variables.description: True if the applicant has supplied proof of ownership/valuation of the collateral asset.

variables.name: hasRequiredDocuments
variables.description: True if all required documents for a secured business loan are supplied: recent/sufficient bank statements, annual accounts, and proof of ownership/valuation of the collateral asset.

variables.name: collateralAssetType
variables.description: The type of asset provided as security for the secured business loan. Must be property, equipment, vehicles, invoices, or intangible assets.

variables.name: hasSecurityAsset
variables.description: True if the applicant provides a valid asset as security (property, equipment, vehicles, invoices, or intangible assets).

variables.name: tradingHistoryMonths
variables.description: The number of months of trading history of the business. A secured business loan requires a minimum of 12 months trading history.

variables.name: meetsMinimumTradingHistory
variables.description: True if the business has at least 12 months of trading history.

variables.name: isSubstantivelyEligible
variables.description: True if the applicant meets all substantive (non-document) eligibility requirements for a secured business loan: UK-based, eligible business type, valid director ID, age-eligible, loan amount in range, loan term in range, has a valid security asset, and meets the minimum 12 months trading history.

variables.name: isUnconditionallyApproved
variables.description: True if the secured business loan is unconditionally approved. Unconditional approval requires both substantive eligibility and completeness of all required documents.
